markets.rules_primary: If the daily published par yield for the 7-year U.S. Treasury is below 4.95% on any business day between Nov 1, 2026 and Nov 30, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
This market covers the period between Nov 1, 2026 and Nov 30, 2026.
Resolution is based solely on the Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rate for the 7-year generic constant-maturity tenor as published by the U.S. Department of the Treasury for each business day in this period; intraday values are not considered.
Revisions to the Underlying made after Expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.

Expiration
If the threshold is met, the market may expire early in accordance with Rule 7.2.
Otherwise, the market will expire at 10:00 AM ET on the calendar day after the final day of the period.
If an Expiration Value cannot be determined, the Contract is subject to Rule 7.1 of the Rulebook.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of distinct days Donald Trump is photographed in a tagged editorial photo on Getty Images between Nov 23, 2026 and Nov 29, 2026 is exactly 3, then the market resolves to Yes.

How this is resolved

If a tagged photo does not actually depict Donald Trump, or is materially mis-tagged (for example, with the wrong date), Kalshi reserves the right to disregard that photo when resolving the market.
Conversely, if a photo is correctly tagged as depicting Donald Trump but its metadata date does not reflect the actual date the photo was taken (in local time), Kalshi reserves the right to include that photo based on the actual date.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If any federal court issues a temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction or other order barring the government from closing East Potomac Park or East Potomac Golf Links to the public for any period after Nov 28, 2026 in D.C. Preservation League v. Department of the Interior (D.D.C. No. 1:26-cv-00477), any appeal of that action, or any other action challenging the closure of East Potomac Park before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by any federal court in D.C. Preservation League v. Department of the Interior (D.D.C. No. 1:26-cv-00477), any appeal of that action, or any other action challenging the closure of East Potomac Park
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

An order extending the Nov 14, 2026 temporary restraining order beyond Nov 28, 2026 counts, as does a new restraining order or a preliminary or permanent injunction. An order that keeps either the golf course or the rest of the park open to the public counts, even if it lets the other close. Temporary closures it allows for seawall repair, routine maintenance or an imminent safety threat do not stop it from counting. A qualifying ruling counts when issued, even if it is stayed, vacated, or reversed.

The government's agreement or promise to keep the park open does not qualify unless a court enters it as a written order.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
The Nov 14, 2026 temporary restraining order as issued, which runs through Nov 28, 2026
An order that only limits tree cutting or construction, or only requires advance notice of a closure, without barring the closure itself
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls
